axes_units: x-axis: Date from 1 January 2020 to 1 March 2023; y-axis: Number of reported deaths, scale from 0 to 25,000
summary: The figure shows the total reported COVID-19 deaths by WHO region up to 11 March 2023. The Region of the Americas has the highest number of reported deaths, followed by the European Region. The African Region has the lowest reported deaths. The stacked area chart on the right illustrates the temporal trend of reported deaths, with peaks occurring at various times across regions, notably high in early 2021 and late 2021.
